title: Magnolia Way | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked within the charming community of WaterColor, this beautifully designed three-story retreat offers a refined coastal escape surrounded by scenic trails, lush greenery, and easy access to the beach. Bright, airy interiors showcase crisp white shiplap walls, rich hardwood floors, and a calming palette inspired by the coast. The open living, dining, and kitchen area is filled with natural light from expansive windows and French doors, creating a warm and inviting space for gathering. A chef-inspired kitchen with marble countertops and premium appliances flows effortlessly into the dining area and comfortable living room, while the screened porch with an outdoor fireplace provides a relaxing setting to unwind after a day by the water. Outdoor living is just as inviting, featuring a private pool and sitting spa surrounded by lounge seating perfect for sun-soaked afternoons. Multiple porches and balconies throughout the home offer peaceful spots to enjoy morning coffee or evening conversations beneath the coastal sky. Upstairs, thoughtfully designed guest suites and playful bunk spaces create welcoming retreats for both adults and younger guests, while the top floor offers a cozy media lounge ideal for movie nights and late-night storytelling. With bikes and a golf cart included for exploring nearby beaches, parks, dining, and shopping, this elegant WaterColor getaway delivers a perfect balance of comfort, style, and classic 30A charm.
